name: Swordsinger
notes: Role: light tank or melee damage that also carries songs. On L2Toggle the board gives the songs, so the SWS fights and does not sing.
Weapon: sword (one-handed + shield, or a duals or two-handed sword build [G]). Deadly Strike accepts SWORD/BLUNT/DAGGER/POLE/DUAL [DP].
1-19: table 1.1 with a sword. 20-39: table 1.3; Aggression only if the SWS is the party's tank.
Song rows are ordered by the guide's fallback priority (Earth > Hunter > Warding > Wind > Life), then the other songs.
Guide gap note: no H5 PvE rotation guide was found for the Swordsinger; untagged rows are [?].
